incidents.summary: An inherited child-Agent context has no mechanical execution-fabric gate preventing mutation of parent UAOS authority.
System maintenance could use evolution concepts without exposing a durable/user-visible lifecycle trace, making it indistinguishable from ad-hoc editing.

failure_classes.name: Ownership exists in topology but is not enforced at authoritative mutation admission
failure_classes.hypothesis: Adding a fail-closed same-owner authority gate before ApprovalGate/executor dispatch will prevent child-to-parent and cross-domain mutation while preserving read access and explicit owner handoff.

failure_classes.name: Governed evolution is implemented but not surfaced as maintenance state
failure_classes.hypothesis: Persisting the active evolution record and reporting its lifecycle state in inherited maintenance responses will make self-evolution auditable without duplicating the evolution controller.

proposal.title: Enforce owner-scoped authoritative writes and expose governed evolution trace
added_mechanisms: Execution-fabric AuthorityScopeGate bound to the selected authority context
Fail-closed same-owner mutation rule with cross-scope handoff/proposal semantics
Evolution lifecycle field in inherited system-maintenance progress reporting
replaced_mechanisms: Implicit or invisible self-evolution usage during maintenance
retired_mechanisms: Treating Git main-branch protection as a substitute for parent/child authority isolation
proposal.why_not_reuse: ApprovalGate binds an exact action, target and parameter hash but has no selected-Agent/owner scope. Topology records owner/parent relationships but is not consulted by ActionCoordinator. Git branch protection is repository-level and cannot express the active inherited Agent authority context.
proposal.retirement_rationale: The new gate reuses existing topology/ownership semantics and ActionCoordinator instead of adding a second permission system; branch protection remains optional defense-in-depth only.
proposal.rollback_plan: Revert the authority-gate release commit and restore the prior ActionCoordinator/ExecutionRequest API; retain this incident record as evidence and mark the proposal ROLLED_BACK.
proposal.expected_benefit: A child/domain Agent cannot authoritatively mutate UAOS or another domain through the UAOS execution path; system maintenance exposes whether governed evolution was triggered and its current lifecycle state.
new_failure_modes: Legacy mutating callers without target_authority fail closed until migrated
Direct host connector writes outside the UAOS execution path remain a host-level enforcement gap unless connector permissions are separately scoped
required_scenarios: video child context -> video write: allow
video child context -> UAOS write: block
video child context -> financial_writing write: block
UAOS context -> video direct business write: block and require owner handoff
read-only cross-scope access: allow under retrieval policy
mutating request missing authority metadata: fail closed
system-maintenance final report exposes evolution lifecycle state

promotion.host_scope_note: Mechanical inside ActionCoordinator; raw ChatGPT GitHub connector remains outside Python interception and is explicitly lower-assurance.
